query:
UPDATE courses SET previewVideoUrl = CASE 
  WHEN title LIKE '%Data%' THEN 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ua-CiDNNj30'
  WHEN title LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WxDlWwcJlFI'
  WHEN title LIKE '%Web%' THEN 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qz0aGYrrlhU'
  WHEN title LIKE '%IA%' OR title LIKE '%Intelligence%' THEN 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ad79nDPuVGc'
  ELSE NULL
END WHERE previewVideoUrl IS NULL
